# Claude-Email-App

> Android app for sending commands to AI agents through a running claude-email service and reading their replies, using your own email account.

Connect one email account, send commands to projects, and read the replies grouped into conversations. Built in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose. Available in English and Danish.
